note: Provisional bank distilled from indexed summaries of Roemmele's 'Psyop AI Prompt Detector' (2026-06-24), the Deep Truth Mode ethos, SemEval-2020 T11 techniques, and Nimmo's Ds. Reconcile against the actual transcript via docs/RECONCILE.md. Ids are not sent to the model; instructions carry the full meaning.

primary_source.instructions: Does the text cite a verifiable primary source, such as a named document, dataset, court filing, on-record named witness, or official record, rather than only anonymous or secondary authority?

criteria.true: At least one named, checkable primary source is cited
criteria.false: Only anonymous sources, unnamed experts, or other outlets are cited, or no source at all

manufactured_urgency.instructions: Does the text press the reader to feel that immediate action or belief is required, beyond what the stated facts justify?

one_sided.instructions: On a contested matter, does the text present only one side while omitting or dismissing plausible counter-explanations that a careful reader would expect to see addressed? Answer false for straightforward factual reports with nothing contested.

tribal_signal.instructions: Does the text frame the matter as in-group versus out-group (us versus them, patriots versus traitors, real people versus elites) rather than as a factual question?

genre.instructions: What kind of text is this, judged by its form and voice?

criteria.reporting: News report: who, what, when, where, attributed claims
criteria.opinion: Editorial, column, or argued essay with a stated point of view
criteria.satire: Humor or parody not meant to be read literally
criteria.social_post: Short social-media style post or thread

technique.instructions: Which persuasion technique is most prominent in the text, if any?

criteria.loaded_language: Emotionally charged words chosen to sway rather than describe
criteria.name_calling: Labeling a target with insulting or dismissive terms
criteria.exaggeration: Overstating or understating scale, effect, or certainty
criteria.appeal_to_fear: Promoting support by instilling fear or anxiety
criteria.flag_waving: Justifying by appeal to national or group identity
criteria.causal_oversimplification: Assuming one cause when several exist
criteria.slogans: Brief striking phrases carrying emotional appeal
criteria.appeal_to_authority: Claim is true because an authority said so, without evidence
criteria.black_and_white: Presenting only two options when more exist
criteria.bandwagon: Everyone agrees, so you should too
criteria.whataboutism_red_herring: Deflecting by pointing elsewhere or introducing irrelevant material

nimmo_d.instructions: Which narrative move dominates the text, if any?

criteria.dismiss: Attacks or dismisses critics or the messenger
criteria.distort: Twists facts or reframes events to fit a narrative
criteria.distract: Changes the subject or points elsewhere
criteria.dismay: Aims to frighten, demoralize, or overwhelm

emotional_engineering.instructions: How engineered is the emotional response the text aims for?
criteria: Neutral report; emotion arises only from the facts
Mild coloring; a few charged words
Clearly loaded; word choice steers feeling throughout
Designed to inflame; outrage or fear is the point
Pure outrage bait; almost no informational content

verifiability.instructions: How verifiable are the central claims from the text alone?
criteria: Anonymous authority only (sources say, experts warn)
Named secondary sources (other outlets, named commentators)
Named primary source (document, official record, on-record witness)
Primary source plus a link or citation to the document or data

engineered_likelihood.instructions: Overall, judged from the text alone, how much does this read like an engineered narrative built to move an audience rather than organic reporting or honest argument?
criteria: Organic: reads like ordinary reporting or honest argument
Slightly shaped: some framing choices but nothing systematic
Likely engineered: multiple techniques working together
Textbook engineered: urgency, tribal framing, unverifiable claims, and loaded language together
